notes: Feed and Official expose a visible common playback failure with one explicit retry of the same source on Android, Web/Wasm and iOS.
Web Official uses the in-app real HTML video decoder. Cross-origin isolation adds crossorigin only when required; remote media still requires HTTPS and HTTP is limited to loopback fixtures.
Android requires Media3 STATE_READY and does not infer active playback when the API 35 emulator leaves the ready decoder paused.

The Android and Web runtime executions were made on prepared commit 27740dd4. All 25 runtime product blobs are identical in Product SHA 806b00a9; the final binding-only changes update the fail-closed capability hash and inventory.
The iOS three-case XCTest was renewed on runtime head 39e31e7f. Product SHA 806b00a9 keeps every runtime/test source byte-identical and adds only the capability hash plus inventory reconciliation.

This unit closes recoverable playback/decoder failure for Feed and Official. It does not claim an exhaustive codec or transport matrix, prolonged background playback, download/share, comments, or other media producers.

A public read-only compatibility probe found the current production page is not cross-origin isolated. If hosting later enables COEP require-corp, historical media without CORS/CORP must be migrated or served under a compatible policy.
